title: Across Protocol restores website after hackers hijack domain
summary: The cross-chain bridge said a social engineering attack targeting domain registrar Namecheap allowed hackers to redirect users to a phishing site.

title: Crypto ally Tom Emmer elected House GOP minority whip
summary: The Minnesota lawmaker, who helped establish the Congressional Crypto Caucus, will stay on as Republican whip after Democrats won the midterms.

title: LNbits rushes emergency patch after reported Bitcoin wallet thefts
summary: The project warned that installations running older versions were vulnerable and urged operators to replace potentially exposed credentials even after upgrading.

title: CFTC warns Kalshi of imminent charges over notification of contracts: Politico
summary: The prediction markets operator says the issue involves procedural errors affecting a handful of contracts, many of which weren’t live, according to Politico.

title: Global banks commit $270M to stablecoin venture targeting 2027 launch
summary: Project Faro, backed by Goldman Sachs, Citigroup and BBVA, has secured $270 million in funding to launch a US dollar stablecoin in the first half of 2027.

title: Can crypto trust firms compete with banks in US derivatives settlements?
summary: Crypto custodians are moving into a market handling billions in daily settlements, but regulatory relief and a shift in congressional control leave questions over their long-term role.

title: Across Protocol warns users to avoid app amid reports of drained wallets
summary: The protocol is investigating a potential security incident affecting its domain, while several users have reported losing funds after interacting with the platform.

title: Ava Labs exec says NYSE deal marks end of blockchain’s ‘general purpose era’
summary: Ava Labs’ John Nahas said the collaboration with the NYSE shows institutions moving past pilots toward purpose-built onchain market infrastructure.

title: Kimber Digital Securities gains broker-dealer status for tokenized assets
summary: The Plume affiliate plans to offer tokenized US stocks, ETFs and bonds through self-custodial wallets, with traditional shareholder rights preserved.

title: Mercado Bitcoin to resume cash withdrawals after $49M hack
summary: Starting next week, customers can deposit and withdraw money through Brazil’s instant payment system. Crypto transfers remain suspended.
